text: futures require specific resources capabilities (e.g., RNG, packages, globals) order evaluated. can declared via function. addition, function can control futures evaluated, including collected futures (e.g., standard output conditions). can also control future scheduled, including set futures partitioned (e.g. chunking).

title: Options controlling resources, scheduling and evaluation of futures — futurize_options
code: futurize_options(   seed = FALSE,   globals = TRUE,   packages = NULL,   stdout = TRUE,   conditions = "condition",   scheduling = 1,   chunk_size = NULL,   ... )

title: Options controlling resources, scheduling and evaluation of futures — futurize_options
text: seed (resource; optional) TRUE, random seed, , state random number generator (RNG) set statistically sound random numbers produced (also parallelization). FALSE (default), assumed future expression neither needs uses random number generation. use fixed random seed, specify L'Ecuyer-CMRG seed (seven integers) regular RNG seed (single integer).  latter, L'Ecuyer-CMRG seed automatically created based given seed. Furthermore, FALSE, future monitored make sure use random numbers.  depending value option future.rng.onMisuse, check ignored, informative warning, error produced. seed NULL, effect seed = FALSE without RNG check performed. globals (resource; optional) logical, character vector, named list control globals handled. details, see section 'Globals used future expressions' help future(). packages (resource; optional) character vector specifying packages attached R environment evaluating future, addition packages required global variables specified identified via argument globals. stdout (evaluation) TRUE (default), standard output captured, re-outputted value() called. FALSE, output silenced (sinking null device outputted). Using stdout = structure(TRUE, drop = TRUE) causes captured standard output dropped future object soon relayed. can help decrease overall memory consumed captured output across futures. Using stdout = NA fully avoids intercepting standard output; behavior unhandled standard output depends future backend. conditions (evaluation) character string condition classes captured relayed.  default relay conditions, including messages warnings.  drop conditions, use conditions = character(0). Errors always relayed. Attribute exclude can used ignore specific classes, e.g. conditions = structure("condition", exclude = "message") capture condition classes except inherit message class. Using conditions = structure(..., drop = TRUE) causes captured conditions dropped future object soon relayed, e.g. value(f). can help decrease overall memory consumed captured conditions across futures. Using conditions = NULL (recommended) avoids intercepting conditions, except errors; behavior unhandled conditions depends future backend environment R runs. scheduling (scheduling) Average number futures ("chunks") per worker. 0.0, single future used process elements. 1.0 TRUE, one future per worker used. 2.0, worker process two futures (enough elements). Inf FALSE, one future per element used. used chunk_size NULL. chunk_size (scheduling) average number elements per future ("chunk"). Inf, elements processed single future. NULL, argument scheduling used. ... Additional named options.

title: Options used by futurize — zzz-futurize.options
text: R futurize.* options can set corresponding environment variable R_FUTURIZE_* futurize package loaded. means environment variables must set futurize package loaded order effect. example, R_FUTURIZE_DEBUG=true, option futurize.debug set TRUE (logical).

title: Version 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-12

title: Version 1.0.0
text: Changed package license permissive Apache License (>= 2).

title: Version 1.0.0
text: Add support domain-specific CRAN package DiceKriging, e.g. m <- km(~., design = design, response = response, multistart = 8) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package ez, e.g. rt <- ezBoot(data = ANT, dv = rt, wid = subnum, within = .(cue, flank), = group) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package modelsummary, e.g. tbl <- modelsummary(models) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package parameters, e.g. fit <- bootstrap_model(model, iterations = 1000) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package pls, e.g. m <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 10, data = yarn, validation = "CV") |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package pvclust, e.g. fit <- pvclust(mtcars, nboot = 1000) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package rugarch, e.g. roll <- ugarchroll(spec, sp500ret, n.start = 1000) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package sandwich, e.g. v <- vcovBS(fit) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package Sim.DiffProc, e.g. res <- MCM.sde(mod1d, statistic = stat, R = 100) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package SuperLearner, e.g. res <- CV.SuperLearner(Y = Y, X = X, SL.library = SL.library) |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce CRAN package stars, e.g. sm <- st_apply(s, MARGIN = 1, FUN = mean) |> futurize().

title: Version 1.0.0
text: Update SingleCellExperiment scuttle examples tests use scuttle::perFeatureQCMetrics() instead deprecated scuttle::perCellQCMetrics().

title: Version 1.0.0
text: futurize() use seed = TRUE gamlss::gamlssCV(). futurize() boot::censboot() produce error “parallel::clusterEvalQ() supported FutureCluster clusters. Ignoring expression: library(survival)”.

text: CRAN release: 2026-04-01

title: Version 0.3.0
text: Add support descending calls wrapped (). Add default future labels reflect function call futurized. Errors produced unsupported call attempted now includes version futurize package.

title: Version 0.3.0
text: futurize(label = name) ignored crossmap purrr calls.

title: Version 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-03-18 Following initial CRAN release January 2026, version adds futurize() support many CRAN Bioconductor packages. achieve , support transpiling S3 S4 methods added, expanding beyond regular generic functions. opens door futurizing many packages going forward.

title: Version 0.2.0
text: Add support futurizing S3 methods S3 generic defined another package. Add support futurizing S4 methods S4 generic defined another package.

title: Version 0.2.0
text: Add support disabling futurize() transpilation via R option futurize.enable, may set via environment variable R_FUTURIZE_ENABLE package loaded.

title: Version 0.2.0
text: Add support map-reduce CRAN package pbapply, e.g. y <- pblapply(...)  |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package DESeq2, e.g. dds <- DESeq(dds) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package fgsea, e.g. res <- fgsea(pathways, stats) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package GenomicAlignments, e.g. se <- summarizeOverlaps(features, bam_files) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package fwb, e.g. b <- fwb(data, statistic, R = 1000) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package gamlss, e.g. cv <- gamlssCV(y ~ pb(x), data = abdom, K.fold = 10) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package glmmTMB, e.g. pr <- profile(m) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package kernelshap, e.g. ks <- kernelshap(model, X = x_explain, bg_X = bg_X) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package GSVA, e.g. es <- gsva(gsvaParam(expr, geneSets)) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package metafor, e.g. pr <- profile(fit) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package partykit, e.g. cf <- cforest(dist ~ speed, data = cars) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package riskRegression, e.g. sc <- Score(list("CSC" = fit), data = d, formula = Hist(time, event) ~ 1, times = 5, B = 100, split.method = "bootcv") |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package scater, e.g. sce <- runPCA(sce) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific Bioconductor package scuttle, e.g. sce <- logNormCounts(sce) |> futurize(). Add support Bioconductor package Rsamtools, e.g. counts <- countBam(bamViews) |> futurize(). Add support Bioconductor package SingleCellExperiment, e.g. result <- applySCE(sce, perCellQCMetrics) |> futurize(). Add support Bioconductor package sva, e.g. adjusted <- ComBat(dat, batch) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package seriation, e.g. o <- seriate_best(d_supreme) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package SimDesign, e.g. res <- runSimulation(design, replications = 1000, generate, analyse, summarise) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package shapr, e.g. result <- explain(model, x_explain, x_train, approach, phi0) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package strucchange, e.g. bp <- breakpoints(Nile ~ 1) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package TSP, e.g. tour <- solve_TSP(USCA50, method = "nn", rep = 10) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package vegan, e.g. md <- mrpp(dune, Management) |> futurize().

title: Version 0.2.0
text: futurize() option chunk_size silently ignored transpilers relying doFuture. futurize() failed descend wrapped calls local() suppressWarnings() specified additional arguments. example, local({ lapply( ... ) }, envir = env) |> futurize() produce parsing error. Packages supporting specifying random seed now produce informative error message futurize(seed = <numeric>) specified, e.g. boot, glmmTMB, lme4, mgcv, vegan.

title: Version 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-01-22 first version submitted CRAN.

title: Version 0.0.6
text: Add support domain-specific CRAN package mgcv, e.g. b <- bam(...) |> futurize().

title: Version 0.0.6
text: Add supported_packages() supported_package_functions(). Rename argument chunk.size chunk_size. Add custom print() method transpiled calls attributes displayed arguments content. Transpiler can now handle nested, complex wrapped expressions. Error messages now suggest using %% trying futurize foreach() %dopar% %dofuture%. Error messages now distinguish infix operators (e.g. %%) functions (e.g. lapply()).

title: Version 0.0.5
text: Add support futurizing calls nested one layers { ... }, ( ... ), local( ... ), (), identity(), e.g. local({ lapply(x, f) }) |> futurize() local({ lapply(x, f) |> futurize() }).

title: Version 0.0.4
text: Add support domain-specific CRAN package tm, e.g. m <- tm_map(crude, content_transformer(tolower)) |> futurize().

title: Version 0.0.4
text: Handle nested transpilers. Add futurize(= {condition}) futurizing conditioned R expression runtime, e.g. lapply(xs, fun) |> futurize(= (length(xs) > 10)). Add futurize(FALSE) futurize(TRUE) disabling enabling futurizing calls.

title: Version 0.0.3
text: Add support domain-specific CRAN package caret, e.g. model <- train(Species ~ ., data = iris, method = "rf", trControl = ctrl) |> futurize(). Add support times() %:% foreach, require special care comes passing future options, e.g. futurize(seed = FALSE).

title: Version 0.0.3
text: default future options futurize() now customized work cases, e.g. need declare seed = TRUE replicate(3, rnorm(1)) |> futurize(). futurize() gained argument eval, can used return futurized expression instead evaluating .

title: Version 0.0.2
text: futurize package unifies current future.apply, furrr, doFuture solutions minimal, unified API. means longer need learn future-specific packages APIs, need know ... |> futurize() syntax. default behavior futurize() sufficient use cases users, , needed, comes one unifying, unique set arguments can used configure futures resolved, partitioned chunks, output conditions relayed, among things.

title: Version 0.0.2
text: Add support base R, e.g. y <- lapply(xs, fcn) |> futurize(), y <- (xs, idxs, fcn) |> futurize(), xs <- kernapply(x, k) |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce CRAN package purrr, e.g. y <- map(xs, fcn) |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce CRAN package crossmap, e.g. y <- xmap_dbl(xs, fcn) |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce CRAN package foreach, e.g. y <- foreach(x = xs) %% { fcn(x) } |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce CRAN package plyr, e.g. y <- llply(xs, fcn) |> futurize(). Add support map-reduce Bioconductor package BiocParallel, e.g. y <- bplapply(xs, fcn) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package boot, e.g. b <- boot(data, statistic, R = 1000) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package glmnet, e.g. cv <- cv.glmnet(x, y) |> futurize(). Add support domain-specific CRAN package lme4, e.g. gm <- allFit(gm) |> futurize().

title: Version 0.0.1
text: Implemented working proof--concept futurize() function takes call expression base-R apply function transpiles runs parallel via futures. works transpiling original map-reduce call evaluate iteration via lazy, vanilla future. futures partitioned chunks, number chunks defaults number parallel workers. futures chunk merged single future. futures launched parallel current future backend. resolved, results reduced back structure original base R apply function return.
